decisions.question: Dry-run scope for the HD-art phase: which batch first?
options: one of each to prove the loop
decisions.context: 11/30 mechs, 3/12 vehicles, 7/20 buildings have HD meshes
decisions.answer: superseded by D2: the mech batch is already running in another session

decisions.question: The remaining mechs are being generated by another session's hd_batch chain on GPU0. What should the swarm's first batch be?
options: review+record the chain's mech outputs as they land (CPU/Godot only: sheets, orientation pre-screen, provenance rows, gate) — no GPU0 use
wait for the chain to finish, then vehicles+buildings on GPU0
pause the other chain and let the swarm own the whole HD batch
decisions.context: 13+ mechs installed, 21 lack provenance/fit; the review+record half exercises every swarm stage except generation
decisions.answer: review+record the chain's mech outputs as they land; no GPU0 use

decisions.question: 7 HD mechs have failed review 3-4 times (atlas, laohu, madcat, thor, vulture, mediumcopter, heavycopter). How should they be handled?
options: one more batch with the planned seeds, then decide
accept the near-misses I list, retry the rest
keep the original model for these 7 for now (HD 23/30)
decisions.context: sheets: swarm/gallery/review_mechs_1.png, review_mechs_2.png; near-misses = good concept, mesh fault only
decisions.answer: trial SolidCraft for the thin parts (vulture lower legs, heavycopter rotor); hold the other 5 until the trial is judged

decisions.question: CAD Vulture (Mad Dog style after Syllogy, CC BY-NC-SA): approve the look, and how to handle the licence before it goes in the public repo?
options: approve; credit Syllogy and mark the vulture model CC BY-NC-SA
approve; ask Syllogy for permission first, keep it local until then
not this route; keep the Hunyuan/original vulture
decisions.context: sheets: swarm/gallery/vulture_cad_ingame.png (in-engine, team paint, walk) and vulture_cad_vs_reference.png; 5032 tris; built by tools/cad/vulture_hd.py + tools/art/cad_mech.py; uncommitted
decisions.answer: add the adapted Syllogy model with the attribution CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 requires (credit, link, licence link, changes listed, adaptation under the same licence, no endorsement)

decisions.question: 13 Syllogy adaptations are installed locally (3 approved, 10 for your look call). How to proceed?
options: fix the tool (clean hip cuts + arm joints) and re-run all 14 non-approved before deciding
accept all 13 as they are now
keep only the 3 approved; restore the other 10
decisions.context: sheets swarm/gallery/stl_<mech>.png; at game distance they are a clear step up, close up seams and arm tears show

decisions.question: HD look calls for 30 adapted models (review page https://claude.ai/artifact/WjgV9VSnBsRhxv1A1APJgJ)
options: approve / keep old / redo per model
decisions.context: 9 mechs + 21 vehicles/copters built from CC sculpts
decisions.answer: approve 23 (catapult cyclops shadowcat thor werewolf aerospotter ambulance cargotruck centipede drillson fueltruck harasser hetzer hunter legion lrmc mobilehq ordnancetruck storm trooptransport truck vedette heavycopter); redo 7 (highlander uller urbanmech zeus mog repairtruck swarmlrmc)

issues.title: Provenance backfill: 21 HD assets lack fit/turn data or a row
issues.detail: hd_provenance --require-fit fails: rows for the 2026-10-19 batch say 'not recorded'; vehicles/objects rows missing or named differently (lrmc vs 'LRM carrier'). Fix: hd_mech.py now writes original/hd/<asset>/provenance.json; rerun --from-step 4 --to-step 5 per asset under the godot lock (CPU only, ~1 min each) and regenerate the rows from the JSON.
issues.note: 13 mech rows backfilled from provenance.json (step-4 re-fit); hd_mech.py writes it from now on; lrmc row id fixed; gate re-run

issues.title: HD jaegermech: reseed_mesh
issues.detail: Orientation right (front at yaw 35, pre-screen agrees); concept seed 7 clean. HD mesh broken: loose debris fragments on the right of the torso at both yaws, chest around the cockpit partly hollow, twin barrels merged into flat slabs. Fit 0.519 m looks fine only because bounds match. Change --mesh-seed (4242), keep concept seed 7.
issues.note: fixed in batch 2: jaegermech approved in review wf_184c9edf-383

issues.title: HD starslayer: reseed_concept
issues.detail: The concept drifted. The original has a narrow torso with a humped head, a cockpit, shoulder barrels and one arm sticking out to the right. The concept turned it into a wide square box with two launcher pods. The HD mesh followed the concept, so the HD yaw-35 silhouette has a much larger, blockier upper body than the original, and the legs became rounded, deep-bent knees. Orientation looks right and the mesh is intact. The fault is the concept, not the mesh. Fit 0.953 m. Prescreen disagreed (original yes, HD no); by eye the HD view is the front.
issues.note: fixed in batch 2: starslayer approved in review wf_184c9edf-383

issues.title: HD urbanmech: reseed_mesh
issues.detail: The mesh has a debris field: loose triangles scattered around both feet in both the yaw-35 and yaw-215 renders. The weapons melted into rounded lumps on the sides of the dome, where the original has a distinct autocannon barrel on the left and a gun on the right. The concept is clean and faithful (dropped the two antennas, acceptable). New mesh seed, not a new concept. Fit 0.542 m. Prescreen disagreed (original yes, HD no); recheck orientation after the remesh.
issues.note: urbanmech: mesh redone in batch 2 (seed 4242, debris gone); remaining fault is orientation, see I38

issues.title: HD werewolf: turn
issues.detail: The HD model looks backwards. In the original yaw-35 view the dorsal fin is left of centre and the long launcher block runs out to the left; in the HD yaw-35 view the fin is right of centre, and the HD yaw-215 view matches the original layout. Provenance orientation check was ambiguous (0.675 as fitted vs 0.603 turned, turn=false); prescreen also disagreed. Concept is faithful. After the turn, recheck the knees: gap between thigh and shin, and a yellow band on the shins that looks like a paint-mask mistransfer. Fit 0.52 m.
issues.note: re-fit with --turn, fit 0.456 m, front checked by eye; review_werewolf_turn.png

issues.title: HD highlander: reseed_concept
issues.detail: Front is right: canopy and chest face the camera at yaw 35. But the concept (seed 7) changed a weapon. The original's arm on the viewer's right ends in a short boxy gun. The concept stretched it into a long gun barrel that reaches well past the body, and the HD mesh copied it. The big box gun on the other arm also gained a hexagonal muzzle opening. That breaks the rule that weapon placement must match the original. The fit of 0.852 m is the worst in the batch, which fits a drifted shape. Legs and torso are intact, with no debris.
issues.note: fixed in batch 2: highlander approved in review wf_184c9edf-383

issues.title: HD hunchback: reseed_concept
issues.detail: Front is right: chest panel and arms face the camera. But the concept (seed 7) swapped the defining weapon. The original has one gun housing on top of the shoulders with a single round muzzle. The concept replaced it with two missile racks, one on each shoulder, and the HD mesh copied them. That is an added weapon and a different silhouette, so the HD no longer reads as this mech. The legs also came out as bent, organic shapes instead of the original's straight piston shins. The mesh itself is sound (fit 0.53 m, no debris), so the fault is in the concept.
issues.note: superseded by I37 (seed 8 already used and drifted; I37 uses seed 12)

issues.title: HD bushwacker: reseed_concept
issues.detail: concept centred a 4-tube rack on a wide symmetric body; the original has an offset right-shoulder launcher. Fit 0.964 m (worst). Milestone-1 mech in mc2_01.
issues.note: fixed in batch 2: bushwacker approved in review wf_184c9edf-383

issues.title: HD werewolf: yellow band on the shins
issues.detail: paint-mask mistransfer at the knee gap, visible at yaw 35 and 215 after the turn
issues.repro: inspect original/hd/werewolf/hd_paint.png around the shin UVs
issues.note: superseded: now an adapted licensed sculpt, approved 2026-10-20

issues.title: mc2_06, mc2_12: units spawned on off-map cells never move (find_path from solid start cell)
issues.detail: game: wave/convoy units start on offmap cells (COST_BLOCKED). sim_world.gd:65 order_move snaps only the goal via nearest_walkable; AStarGrid2D returns empty path from solid start, unit stays HOLD. mc2_06: 8/49 pilots moved, waves never attack HQ. mc2_12: 7/85 moved, convoys parked at x=7445. Original Move.cpp:4379 sets travelOffMap when start is off-map. Fix: allow off-map start, no re-entry.

issues.title: mc2_08, mc2_11 (also mc2_09): parts with Damage >= 1.0 spawn live instead of shutdown/disabled
issues.detail: game: sim_mission.gd:59 reads Damage only for campaign replacement. Original mission.cpp:1106-1124: home part -> SHUTDOWN, off GUI, invisible; enemy part -> DISABLED, sensors off. mc2_08: Atlas counts for Link up at t=0.1, dies alone. mc2_11: 5 salvage-yard mechs fight the lance, secondary b fails. mc2_09: 3 pre-disabled enemies skew DestroyNumber 12.

issues.title: mc2_17: AI units auto-fire at nearest enemy regardless of brain; inert cam dummies start battle before betrayal
issues.detail: game: sim_world.gd _combat/_pick_target fires for every armed unit. Original warrior.cpp fires only at brain/order target; fire-at-will is pbrain only. CamDum_Stien Werewolves shoot Steiner at t=5-14, waking them ~75 s before liaoBetrays (~t=79). Fix: auto-fire only for player-brain units. Also autoplay counts commander-2 dummies as lance LOST.

issues.title: autoplay: lance with only support vehicles left never counts as lost: mc2_10, mc2_15, mc2_22
issues.detail: bot: after all mechs die a live repair truck (commander 0) keeps the mission open per spec B6, but autoplay runs to 1800 s and records PLAYING. mc2_10 s3, mc2_15 s2 (Repairtruck refit=500 unused), mc2_22 s2. Fix in harness: treat no mechs left as loss, or stop calling trucks no mech can use.
issues.note: reclassified by the critic: mc2_15 s1/s3 end LOST with support units alive, s2 does not -> loss condition inconsistent, see I32

issues.title: mc2_01: lance loses the Starslayer extraction fight on seed 2
issues.detail: bot: focuses nearest threat not Starslayer, repairs only when threats empty so enters final fight damaged, ignores powered-down window. Seed 2 lost all 3 to Starslayer after objectives done t=167.8; seeds 1,3,4 won narrowly. Game to spec (extraction needs 1280 wu clear).

issues.title: mc2_06: lance hunts all 44 Liao units, never captures Turret Control, own air strike destroys Sensor Control
issues.detail: bot: _use_support air-strikes Part47/49 cluster 19 m from S_SensorControl (strikes hit friendly, support-powers.md:280), destroyed t=64.6 all seeds. Turret Control capturable at 350 m but _orders stops on obj 1 DestroyAll. Lance worn down at staging points; 1-11 enemies left.

issues.title: mc2_07: 3-mech 145 t FIT lance outmatched by MenShen pair, loses 2 mechs before HQ capture
issues.detail: balance: drop limit 200 t, 6000 RP (one repair truck). MenShen top attacker every seed, Werewolf lost t=108-135, Bushwacker t=278-329, HQ captured t=380-413. Game to spec. Needs replay with 200 t lance to tell encounter tuning from placeholder lance.

issues.title: mc2_07: lone damaged Bushwacker sent 5.4 km to Processing Plant into 2 Catapults
issues.detail: bot: _orders moves to next objective once no threat in 320 m; no retreat, regroup or wait-for-repair. Last mech at 11-18% armour dies to Catapult t=662-808 all seeds.

issues.title: mc2_09: no formation, fast Werewolf arrives alone and dies at 72 s every seed
issues.detail: bot: per-mech orders with no speed matching (Werewolf 27 vs Zeus 19). Werewolf lost t=72.3-72.6 to Partisan all seeds; rest worn down over 4 stages, seeds 1,3 reach the leader. Game to spec, triggers fire.

issues.title: mc2_10: seed 3 lance fed piecemeal into airfield defenders without repairing
issues.detail: bot: goes O1 straight to O2 (Atlas + 6 Centipedes) at ~30% armour, repairs only when threats empty. Seed 3 lost all 5 mechs, 720 damage vs 358-445 in wins; seeds 1,2,4 won. Not balance.

issues.title: mc2_13: FIT lance with no support cannot outlast 44 enemies incl 21 Powered Armor
issues.detail: balance: 260 t lance (over 230 t limit), no support on airless moon. Obj 0,1 done then lance dies with obj 2-4 open every seed; PA top attacker 338-500 dmg. Lance kills 24-35. Bot factors: ShaYu lost first, no regroup. Needs 230 t grouped replay.

issues.title: mc2_14: solo Thor fights every patrol head-on, no avoidance or retreat
issues.detail: bot: engages anything in 320 m, never breaks contact. Thor dies t=335/1213/447 after Gun Alpha, heading 10 km to Gun Beta. Solo 75 t drop, 0 RP, to spec. Seed 2 lasted to 1213 s, so winnable.

issues.title: mc2_15: lance marches straight at nearest Legion through 58-unit base after partisans are spent
issues.detail: bot: ignores secondaries a, c (operative route); partisans die by t=68 before lance arrives; repair truck unused (threats never empty). No objective done, all mechs lost t=415-481, Legion top attacker. Game to spec.

issues.title: mc2_16: bot chases 25 reinforcements nearest-first instead of capturing turrets and HQ and holding
issues.detail: bot: after obj 2 leaves base for obj 3 targets; never tries HQ or turret/gate secondaries. 3 mechs lost in 70 s at ~600-735 s to Madcat/Vulture/ShadowCat. Seed 2 won, so winnable.

issues.title: mc2_17: default 335 t lance with 0 RP destroyed 70-110 s after the betrayal
issues.detail: balance: ~9 Steiner attackers, guard Highlanders, three Liao waves; lost t=145-187, Highlanders ~half the damage. Bot also moves during cinematic (setMovieMode stubbed). Re-check after the auto-fire fix.

issues.title: mc2_18: bot walks into city guard posts nearest-first, loses Anubis alone, skips capture secondaries
issues.detail: bot: DestroyAll read as nearest awake enemy; Anubis lost t=68-136 alone; never captures HQ/Power Gen/Sensor; max 22 kills so 25-kill waves never start. Game to spec. Support use not logged.

issues.title: mc2_19: lance fights 82 enemies nearest-first, no pullback, worn down before 25 kills and extract
issues.detail: bot: no retreat/regroup, repair only with no threats. Kills 28/14/24; s1 completes obj 1, s3 one short. Strike damage (from -1) missing from autoplay damage table; spotter has no LOS check (sim gap).

issues.title: mc2_20: FIT lance ground down by two converging patrols, then dies at dropship
issues.detail: balance: s1Sth/s1Wst patrols cross lance start and pursue; Madcats lost t=83-152; survivors reach dropship t=359-710 and die to Dship groups. 1 of 6 primaries, enemies alive 49 every seed (check). Bot never repairs. Needs 320 t campaign replay.

issues.title: mc2_22: bot marches across map at nearest Elite Guard, fights every patrol and wakes shut-down base
issues.detail: bot: route through EC1 front, Partisan patrols and EC2 shutdown base; Partisans 630-778 dmg, LaoHu woken. Kills only 20-31 of 64, objectives 0,1 untouched. Game to spec.

issues.title: mc2_23: 3-mech 175 t FIT lance with no support worn down after town objective
issues.detail: balance: 76 Steiner units; limit 300 t and 36000 RP unused by autoplay. Obj b done t=212-241, Werewolf lost first, rest by t=449-635, 52-59 enemies left. Game to spec.

issues.title: mc2_24: lance assaults front gate as one group, never triggers fuel-truck rebel attack
issues.detail: bot: hidden obj 4 (4 fuel trucks) open every seed so Rebel_Mech_Attack never fires; worn down by gate group then Legions (260-590 dmg). Kills 28-36 of 64. Game to spec.

issues.title: Loss check inconsistent when only support units survive: mc2_15 s1/s3 LOST, s2 PLAYING to 1800 s; mc2_10 s3, mc2_11 s2, mc2_22 s2 stall
issues.detail: unclear game vs bot: same situation (lance dead, support vehicles alive) ends LOST on some seeds and runs forever on others. Probe: print the units SimObjectives counts as player survivors at each LOST check on mc2_15 s1 vs s2

issues.title: Capture targets destroyed by an unknown attacker early: mc2_06 S_SensorControl t=64.6 (all seeds), mc2_22 LiaoHeavyGateControl t=34.6 (s1)
issues.detail: unclear: diagnosis inferred the bot's own air strike (strikes hit friendly buildings, support-powers.md:280) but autoplay does not log support calls. Probe: log every _use_support call with target and time

issues.title: End-of-run ABL pilot count differs by seed (mc2_11 41/42/42, mc2_22 72/73/73); start counts identical
issues.detail: unclear: likely scripted reinforcements gated on events that depend on the fight, not nondeterminism. Probe: log each pilot spawn with the time and the script line/flag that spawned it on mc2_11 s1 vs s2

issues.title: HD wolfhound: reseed_concept
issues.detail: Orientation is right: the HD at yaw 35 shows the front, the same as the original. But the concept added two large stacked launcher pods on each shoulder, and the original has nothing there except a thin antenna. The HD mesh copied them, so the silhouette and weapon placement no longer match the original. Legs, feet and arms are intact, with no debris or hollow shell. fit_m 0.755 is fine, so the fault is the concept, not the fit. The provenance.json has no concept_seed recorded.

issues.title: HD mediumcopter: reseed_concept
issues.detail: Orientation matches: the nose points lower-right in both the original and the HD at yaw 35. The local-llm said 'side profile' for the original, which is a misread of the angle, not a real flip. The concept drifted: it turned the blue stub-winged VTOL into a grey tank on a track. The tail fin and side wings are gone, and the HD has a track pod hanging underneath. fit_m 0.71 is acceptable, but the shape is wrong. The HD paint also shows purple and teal speckle patches. Concept seed was 7.

issues.title: HD heavycopter: reseed_mesh
issues.detail: The concept is faithful: same blue body, rotor, tail fin and red pods as the original, at the same angle. The HD mesh is broken. It has a large debris ring of loose triangles around it in both the yaw-35 and yaw-215 views, and the body is dark, fragmented and partly hollow. fit_m 2.111 is over the 2 m limit. This is the same symptom as the known Harasser mesh seed 1234 debris ring, and this asset also used mesh_seed 1234, so change the mesh seed (4242 has worked before). The local-llm called the HD 'back' because the mesh is broken, not because it is turned around.

issues.title: HD hunchback: reseed_concept
issues.detail: Concept drifted: single round hunch turret and short side-held arms replaced by twin long shoulder cannons and long hanging arms with hands; leg proportions changed (added weapons, changed silhouette). Mesh intact. Orientation suspect: turned fit scores better (0.689 fitted vs 0.568 turned) yet turn=false; prescreen split. Re-check orientation after concept reseed. fit_m 0.762.

issues.title: HD urbanmech: turn
issues.detail: HD mesh faces the wrong way: yaw-215 cell matches the original front; hd_mech orientation check favoured turned (0.739 vs 0.636) but run has turn=false. Fit 0.425 m, silhouette otherwise fine (antennas lost, acceptable). Rerun with --turn, keep concept seed 7 and mesh seed 4242.

issues.title: HD atlas: reseed_concept
issues.detail: Orientation right, but the concept is cropped (head and top of left shoulder cut off, render_zoom 1.25), so the HD mesh lost the skull head; fit 0.71 m. Redo the concept with a new seed (or without the 1.25 zoom) with a margin, then remesh.

issues.title: HD cyclops: reseed_concept
issues.detail: The concept (seed 7) drifted badly: the hooded single-eye cockpit head became a boxy turret torso with a mast; the single right-arm gun became two symmetrical side cannons. HD mesh copies the drift. Fit 0.952 m. Orientation check preferred turned 180 (0.552 vs 0.815); local-llm called the HD front a rear view. Fix the concept first, then recheck orientation.

issues.title: HD enfield: reseed_mesh
issues.detail: Concept (seed 8) is good and orientation correct. Mesh (seed 1234) is broken: feet shredded into debris fragments in both HD views, horn a broken shard, head and torso melted into a blob. Fit 0.571 m. Try mesh seed 4242.

issues.title: HD laohu: reseed_concept
issues.detail: Orientation looks right (check 0.434 vs 0.601 turned; local-llm rear-view call looks false, confirm by eye after rerun). Concept (seed 8) drifted: the small twin-hole pod became a six-barrel rotary cannon; the hunched slung torso became a flat box torso with decals and hanging cables. Mesh clean, fit 0.595 m. An earlier concept_s7.png is in the folder to compare.

issues.title: HD madcat: reseed_concept
issues.detail: HD yaw 35 shows the front (cockpit and arm-pod muzzles) the same way round as the original, and fit_m is 0.485 (concept seed 7, mesh seed 1234, turn false). The problem is the concept: it is zoomed in and the frame cuts off the tops of both missile racks. The mesh then fused the two separate shoulder racks and the gap between them into one solid slab across the back, plainly visible at yaw 215. That changes the original silhouette, and a concept that crops part of the subject means a new --seed. Legs, feet and arm pods are otherwise fine. The HD texture has purple and green speckle, which all four HD mechs share.

issues.title: HD ryoken: reseed_concept
issues.detail: The concept has drifted badly. It shows a hunched carapace with the canopy on the far side and one twin-gun pod, seen from a different angle than the original. The original's shoulder missile rack and paired arm guns are gone. provenance.json has no concept_seed or step2 entry, so this concept's origin is not recorded. The orientation check against this concept prefers turning 180 degrees (as fitted 0.755, turned 0.484) but turn is false, and since the concept is wrong that check means nothing. HD yaw 35 has the guns pointing the same way as the original and fit_m is 0.392. However, no canopy can be made out and the shoulder missile rack is missing, so the mesh does not keep the original's details. Make a new concept with a fresh --seed and recorded provenance, then re-mesh and check the facing again.

issues.title: HD thor: reseed_concept
issues.detail: Fit 0.513 m, orientation right. Concept (seed 7, render_zoom 1.25) added a large box on the left shoulder beside the single top-mounted missile pod; HD mesh has two tall shoulder blocks with the pod shrunk between them, silhouette no longer matches. Reseed the concept; mesh itself clean.

issues.title: HD vulture: reseed_mesh
issues.detail: Fit 0.462 m but mesh broken: both lower legs missing between knee and ankle pods, debris around feet and left gun muzzle, toe plates gone. Concept is clean and matches; fault is in the mesh. Orientation right.

issues.title: HD mediumcopter: reseed_mesh
issues.detail: Orientation correct at yaw 35 (no turn); prescreen disagreement is spurious (both renders show the same view). Concept seed 11 is faithful: silhouette, dorsal mast/sensor ball, chin gun, red tail stripes, nothing added. Fit 0.691 m (mesh seed 1234, turn false) is in range. Mesh is a leaky shell: white shows through the open tail-boom end and side grille, and torn white speckles run along the belly and lower hull edge (yaw 215). Patchy purple paint-mask blotches likely come from the torn surface. Rerun with a different --mesh-seed, keep concept seed 11; 1234 also gave the Harasser its debris ring.

issues.title: HD heavycopter: reseed_mesh
issues.detail: Concept seed 7 (zoom 1.25) is good: same pose, rotor, tail fin, red missile pods, twin chin guns, nothing added. Mesh seed 4242 is junk: large debris ring (rotor blades fragmented into loose triangles), shredded hull with holes, rotor and pods lost, body sits low and cropped. Fit 1.83 m near the 2 m failure line, driven by debris. Orientation matches original (no turn); prescreen 'rear' verdict is debris clutter. Change --mesh-seed (4242 is the failing seed, so the repro must use a different one, e.g. 1234 or 7777), keep concept seed 7. If the rotor keeps fragmenting, a concept/framing that keeps thin rotor blades out of the mesh may be needed.

issues.title: HD atlas: reseed_concept
issues.detail: The HD faces the right way (skull face visible at yaw 35) and the mesh is whole, but the concept changed the pose and silhouette. The original holds both forearms forward with block fists under big rounded shoulder pods; the concept (seed 12, render_zoom 1.25) crops the head off at the top and redraws the arms hanging straight down with hands, and the HD followed it. The shoulder pods are smaller and the forearms point down instead of forward. Fit 0.83 m is higher than the others. Seeds 7-10 were already rejected, so consider a lower render_zoom so the head isn't cropped, as well as a new seed.

issues.title: HD laohu: reseed_mesh
issues.detail: A flat ring of debris floats above the torso in both HD views: the debris fault Harasser had on mesh seed 1234, the same seed used here. The torso is also a flat wing-like slab with only one barrel, where the original has missile/gun pods on both arms. Fit 0.92 m, and the orientation check was barely decisive (0.590 fitted vs 0.622 turned). Looking at it, the yaw-35 gun points the same way as the original's, so it isn't backwards; the local LLM called hd_front34 a back view, but that view is unreadable because of the slab. The concept (seed 9) also swapped the original's box launchers for twin rotary barrels on a raised deck. Try a new mesh seed first (4242 has worked twice); if the slab and debris persist, reseed the concept too.

issues.title: HD madcat: reseed_concept
issues.detail: The concept (seed 8) drifted. It is drawn straight from the front, not at 3/4. The cockpit canopy is gone, leaving a plain armoured box. The two box-shaped arm gun pods became rounded fist or pod shapes. The HD mesh follows that concept: at yaw 35 it is a bulbous blob, the missile racks have melted into rounded 'ears', the arm guns are lost and there is no readable cockpit, so the silhouette and weapon placement don't match the original. The fit is 0.884 m (provenance.json), poor for a mech. Facing can't be judged on this mesh, and local-llm called the original front-facing but the HD one a back view. Reseed the concept, then check the facing again on the new mesh.

issues.title: HD ryoken: reseed_mesh
issues.detail: The concept is faithful: 3/4 view, the missile box above the canopy, twin guns on each arm, the same legs. The HD yaw-35 render faces the same way as the original, and the arm guns sit in the right places. The fit is good at 0.471 m. However, there are loose debris fragments scattered under both feet in both the yaw-35 and yaw-215 renders. That is a mesh-seed artefact (seed 1234, the same seed that made the Harasser debris ring), so change the mesh seed rather than try to filter it. Separately, the canopy and missile-box detail is smoothed out in the mesh.

issues.title: HD thor: reseed_mesh
issues.detail: The concept matches the original: the shoulder missile pod, the two forward arm barrels, the same legs. The HD yaw-35 render faces the same way as the original, with the missile-pod tubes and arm-gun muzzles toward the camera, and the fit is 0.637 m, acceptable. However, the HD mesh has a vertical fin or mast sticking up from the top of the missile pod. It is in neither the original nor the concept, so the mesher added it, and added masts break the rules. Change the mesh seed (4242 has worked before). Apart from the fin, the silhouette is right.

issues.title: HD vulture: reseed_mesh
